# Akdeinz Motion

> Motion design studio for founders and small brands. Logo stings, social motion ads, product promos, explainers, brand films and monthly retainers. Market: Belgium and the EU first, the US second, worldwide welcome. The deliverable is the rendered video file only (no source or project files).

Pitch: Your time is valuable. Let me take care of it.

Last updated: 2026-11-01

## Packages (EUR, excl. VAT)

- Logo Sting (3–6 s): €390, 3 working days
- Social Motion Ad S (up to 15 s): €490, 3–4 working days
- Social Motion Ad M (up to 30 s): €790, 5 working days
- Product Promo (30–45 s): €1,290, 7 working days
- Explainer (up to 60 s): €1,900, 10–14 working days
- Brand Film (up to 60 s): €2,400, 10–14 working days
- Extra length (Product Promo, Explainer and Brand Film): +15 s, +€600, +2 working days

## Retainers

- Motion Monthly 4: 4 × Social Motion Ad S per month, €1,590 per month, 3 months minimum
- Motion Monthly 8: 8 × Social Motion Ad S per month, €2,890 per month, 3 months minimum

## Included in every package

- 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 versions
- 1080p MP4
- Licensed music and sound design
- 2 revision rounds
- Worldwide, perpetual commercial licence for your own channels and paid ads
- Logo Sting also includes a transparent-background render

## Add-ons

- 4K delivery: +20%
- Extra revision round: €90
- Extra aspect ratio: €60
- Language version: €90
- Copywriting: €150
- Voiceover: At cost
- Rush delivery (under 72 hours): +35%

## Payment

50% to start, 50% after you approve a watermarked preview.
